channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Can contracting measles compromise your immunity to other diseases?
item.description: Yes. Contracting measles can compromise your immunity to other diseases through a phenomenon known as “immune amnesia.”

item.title: Map: See where student enrollment is rising and falling across Colorado
item.description: Statewide enrollment dropped by more than 10,000 students this year, but 46 Colorado districts saw their student counts increase

item.title: Award-winning Vietnamese restaurant in Denver finds its James Beard future on ice
item.description: A monthslong behind-the-scenes battle goes public when sắp sửa chef Ni Nguyen tells his side. Meanwhile, the prestigious restaurant awards organization stays silent.

item.title: Federal judge clears way for luxury Berlaimont developers to build their access road near Edwards through Forest Service land
item.description: The ruling aligns with nearly two dozen others who challenged whether 1980 legislation in Alaska applies in the rest of the country. Environmental groups who sued say they have additional claims still pending.

item.title: Colorado avalanche educators warily eyeing declining numbers of fatalities despite increasing traffic
item.description: What’s behind the falling number of Colorado avalanche incidents? One critical factor in backcountry adventurers’ favor: information.

item.title: Xcel posts nearly $1 billion operating profit from Colorado as the utility seeks rate increases for gas, electric customers
item.description: Settlements related to the Marshall fire trimmed the bottom line to $678 million, the lowest in four years

item.title: Former Colorado state senator sentenced to probation for fabricating letters amid ethics investigation
item.description: Sonya Jaquez Lewis, who resigned from the legislature last year, was convicted of attempting to influence a public servant and forgery

item.title: Colorado gray wolf died from capture-related complications, necropsy shows
item.description: After the 3-year-old gray wolf was captured during a collaring operation, wildlife crews noticed the wolf had a high temperature and had no pulse

item.title: Students at Broomfield High School may have been exposed in Colorado’s latest measles case
item.description: The child who was infected is unvaccinated and had not recently traveled outside of Colorado

item.title: Renee Good, killed by immigration officer in Minneapolis, was “slow to anger, quick to love,” her father says
item.description: In a wide-ranging interview, her parents and siblings describe the joy Good found in life and their hopes that her death can bring change to a deeply polarized nation
